params._bribes: list of bribes to claim rewards from

params._gauges: list of gauges to claim rewards from

params._VTOKEN: VTOKEN address which is used to get voting power
params._bribefactory: BribeFactory address which is used to create bribes
params._gaugefactory: GaugeFactory address which is used to create gauges

params.finish: ending index of gauges to distribute to
params.start: starting index of gauges to distribute to

params._plugins: list of plugins to claim rewards and distribute from

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._plugins: list of plugins to vote on
params._weights: list of weights corresponding to plugins

claimBribes(address[]).notice: Claims rewards for msg.sender from list of bribes.

claimRewards(address[]).notice: Claims rewards for msg.sender from list of gauges.

distribute(address).notice: Distributes OTOKEN to _gauge, notifies gauge contract to start distributing OTOKEN to plugin depositors.

distribute(uint256,uint256).notice: Distributes OTOKEN to gauges from start to finish

distributeToBribes(address[]).notice: Claims voting rewards for each plugin and distributes it to corresponding bribe contracts

notifyRewardAmount(uint256).notice: For the minter to notify the voter contract of the amount of OTOKEN to distribute

reset().notice: Resets msg.sender's votes to zero on all plugins. Can only be called once per epoch.         This is necessary for the user to withdraw staked VTOKENs by setting users voting weight to 0.

vote(address[],uint256[]).notice: Allocates voting power for msg.sender to input plugins based on input weights. Will update bribe balances         to track voting rewards. Makes users voting weight nonzero. Can only be called once per epoch.
